requirement: Delegate compatibility requires equal parameter counts and identical corresponding in, out and ref modifiers.
notes: Published pilot meaning contains both conditions and is preserved; the following atomic rows separately expose each condition.

requirement: A value parameter satisfies delegate compatibility when an identity or implicit reference conversion exists from the delegate parameter type to the corresponding method or delegate parameter type.
notes: Preserves the pilot ID and argument-conversion direction. Source pointers: 10.2.2, 10.2.8.

requirement: Numeric or boxing parameter conversions cannot establish delegate compatibility.
notes: Preserves the pilot ID and exclusion. Source pointers: 10.2.2, 10.2.8.

quote_json: "parameter type in D is the same as the parameter type in M"
requirement: Corresponding in, out and ref parameter types must be identical for delegate compatibility.
notes: Preserves the pilot ID and meaning.

requirement: A returns-no-value delegate and returns-no-value method or delegate satisfy the return-mode compatibility condition.
notes: Preserves the pilot ID and meaning.

requirement: Returns-by-value signatures satisfy return compatibility when an identity or implicit reference conversion exists from the method or source delegate result type to the destination delegate result type.
notes: Preserves the pilot ID and conversion direction. Source pointers: 15.6.1, 20.2.

requirement: Numeric or boxing return conversions cannot establish delegate compatibility.
notes: Preserves the pilot ID and exclusion. Source pointers: 15.6.1, 20.2.

requirement: Returns-by-ref signatures satisfy return compatibility only when their return types have an identity conversion and their ref_kind is identical.
notes: Preserves the published composite pilot meaning; the following atomic rows expose its two conditions.

requirement: A delegate instance encapsulates a nonempty invocation list of callable entities.

quote_json: "consists of an instance and a method on that instance"
requirement: An instance-method callable entity consists of a target instance and a method on that instance.
A static-method callable entity consists only of the method.
A successful delegate invocation passes the supplied arguments to each callable entity in its invocation list.
A delegate declaration introduces a new delegate type.
A delegate declaration may use optional attributes and modifiers followed by delegate, return_type and delegate_header.
A delegate declaration may instead use optional attributes and modifiers followed by delegate, ref_kind, ref_return_type and delegate_header.
A nongeneric delegate header consists of its identifier, parenthesized optional parameters and a semicolon.
A generic delegate header includes a variant type-parameter list and zero or more constraints before the final semicolon.
The delegate_modifier grammar admits new in a permitted declaration context.
The delegate_modifier grammar admits public in a permitted declaration context.
The delegate_modifier grammar admits protected in a permitted declaration context.
The delegate_modifier grammar admits internal in a permitted declaration context.
The delegate_modifier grammar admits private in a permitted declaration context.

requirement: A delegate declaration cannot repeat a modifier.
A delegate declaring its own variant type-parameter list is generic.

quote_json: "delegate nested inside a generic class declaration"
requirement: A delegate nested in a generic class is itself generic.

quote_json: "generic struct declaration is itself a generic delegate declaration"
requirement: A delegate nested in a generic struct is itself generic.

quote_json: "type arguments for the containing type shall be supplied"
requirement: Constructing a nested delegate requires the containing generic type's arguments.

quote_json: "only permitted on delegates declared within another type"
requirement: A delegate declaration cannot use new unless it is nested within another type.

quote_json: "hides an inherited member by the same name"
requirement: A nested delegate's new modifier indicates hiding of an inherited member with the same name.

quote_json: "control the accessibility of the delegate type"
requirement: Delegate accessibility modifiers have the context-dependent meanings described by 7.5.2.
notes: Applies the cited accessibility rules without duplicating their predicates. Source pointers: 7.5.2.

requirement: The declaration's identifier names the delegate type.

quote_json: "if ref is present, the delegate returns-by-ref"
requirement: A delegate with ref returns by reference.

quote_json: "if return_type is void, the delegate returns-no-value"
requirement: A delegate without ref and with void return_type returns no value.
A delegate with neither ref nor void returns by value.
The delegate's formal_parameter_list specifies its parameters.

quote_json: "specifies the type of the result, if any"
requirement: A returns-by-value delegate's return_type specifies its result type.
A returns-by-ref delegate's ref_return_type specifies the type of its returned referenced variable.

quote_json: "specifies the type parameters to the delegate itself"
requirement: The variant type-parameter list specifies the delegate's own type parameters.
notes: The variant grammar and safety definitions are owned by 18.2.3. Source pointers: 18.2.3.

requirement: A delegate's return type must be void or output-safe.

quote_json: "formal parameter types of a delegate type shall be input-safe"
requirement: A delegate cannot have an input-unsafe formal parameter type.

quote_json: "output or reference parameter types shall also be output-safe"
requirement: A delegate's out parameter type must also be output-safe.

quote_json: "output or reference parameter types shall also be output-safe"
requirement: A delegate's ref parameter type must also be output-safe.
A delegate type parameter cannot have an input-unsafe class type constraint.
A delegate type parameter cannot have an input-unsafe interface type constraint.
A delegate type parameter cannot have an input-unsafe type-parameter constraint.
Delegate type equivalence depends on declared type identity rather than structural signature equality.
Constructing a generic delegate type requires its type arguments.
A constructed delegate's parameter types substitute its type arguments for declaration type parameters.

quote_json: "corresponding type argument of the constructed delegate type"
requirement: A constructed delegate's return type substitutes its type arguments for declaration type parameters.

quote_json: "only way to declare a delegate type"
requirement: A delegate type can be declared only with a delegate_declaration.

quote_json: "Every delegate type is a reference type"
requirement: Every delegate type is a reference type.
Every delegate type is implicitly sealed.

quote_json: "not permissible to derive any type from a delegate type"
requirement: No type may derive from a delegate type.
A non-delegate class cannot derive from System.Delegate.

quote_json: "System.Delegate is not itself a delegate type"
requirement: System.Delegate is a class type rather than a delegate type.
Every delegate type inherits System.Delegate's members according to 15.3.4.
Every delegate type provides a nongeneric Invoke method.
Invoke's parameter list matches the delegate declaration's formal parameter list.

quote_json: "return type matches the return_type or ref_return_type"
requirement: Invoke's return type matches the delegate declaration's return_type or ref_return_type.

quote_json: "ref_kind matches that in the delegate declaration"
requirement: A returns-by-ref delegate's Invoke has the delegate declaration's ref_kind.

quote_json: "at least as accessible as the containing delegate type"
requirement: Invoke is at least as accessible as its containing delegate type.

quote_json: "semantically equivalent to using the delegate invocation syntax"
requirement: Calling Invoke has the same semantics as invoking the delegate with delegate invocation syntax.
An implementation may define additional delegate-type members beyond the required members.
notes: This is an explicit permission, not a documented implementation-defined choice.

requirement: Operations applicable to an ordinary class or instance also apply to a delegate class or instance except for the distinct instantiation rules.
A delegate instance may use ordinary member access to access System.Delegate members.
Compatible method or delegate signatures must have equal parameter counts.
Compatible signatures must agree on each corresponding parameter's in, out and ref modifiers.

requirement: Returns-by-ref delegate compatibility requires an identity conversion between the two return types.
Returns-by-ref delegate compatibility requires identical ref_kind.
A delegate instance may be created by a delegate_creation_expression.
A conversion to a delegate type may create a delegate instance.
Delegate combination may create a delegate instance.
Delegate removal may create a delegate instance.

requirement: A delegate created from a static method refers to that method.

quote_json: "target object (which cannot be null) and instance method"
requirement: A delegate created from an instance method refers to its target object and method.
A successfully created instance-method delegate has a non-null target object.
notes: Null-target creation failure mechanics are owned by 12.8.16.6.

requirement: A newly created delegate may refer to another delegate.
A delegate created from one method has exactly one invocation-list entry containing that method.
Combining two non-null delegates creates an invocation list concatenating the left operand's list before the right operand's list.
A delegate created from a single delegate has one invocation-list entry containing that source delegate.
Delegates may be combined using binary + according to 12.10.5.
Delegates may be combined using += according to 12.21.4.
A delegate may be removed from a delegate combination using binary - according to 12.10.6.
A delegate may be removed from a delegate combination using -= according to 12.21.4.
Delegates may be compared for equality according to 12.12.9.

quote_json: "always refers to the same invocation list"
requirement: An instantiated delegate's invocation list never changes.

quote_json: "invokes the one method with the same arguments it was given"
requirement: Invoking a non-null delegate with one invocation-list entry calls its target with the supplied arguments.

quote_json: "returns the same value as the referred to method"
requirement: A single-entry delegate invocation returns its target method's result unchanged.

quote_json: "search for an exception catch clause continues"
requirement: An exception uncaught in a single-entry delegate target propagates to the delegate caller as though it directly called the target.
A multicast delegate invokes its invocation-list methods synchronously in list order.
Every invoked method in a multicast invocation receives the supplied arguments.
Every invoked method in a multicast invocation with a ref parameter receives a reference to the same argument variable.

quote_json: "visible to methods further down the invocation list"
requirement: A multicast target's changes to a ref argument variable are visible to subsequent targets.

quote_json: "final value will come from the invocation of the last delegate"
requirement: A completed multicast invocation's out parameter values come from its last invoked entry.

quote_json: "final value will come from the invocation of the last delegate"
requirement: A completed multicast invocation's return value comes from its last invoked entry.

quote_json: "search for an exception catch clause continues"
requirement: An exception uncaught in a multicast target propagates to the delegate caller.

quote_json: "methods further down the invocation list are not invoked"
requirement: An uncaught multicast target exception prevents invocation of the remaining entries.
Invoking a null delegate throws System.NullReferenceException.
